name: travel-orchestrator
description: Plans multi-city trips by delegating to flight, hotel and activity agents over A2A. Handles itineraries, price checks and rebooking flows across providers.

skills.name: Plan trip
skills.description: Builds a full multi-city itinerary with budget constraints, layover rules and loyalty preferences

skills.name: Rebooking
skills.description: Rebooks disrupted legs automatically when carrier schedule changes are detected

skills.name: Price watch
skills.description: Monitors fare drops on saved routes and reports delta against purchase price

skills.name: Visa check
skills.description: Checks visa requirements and transit rules for each passport-leg combination

skills.name: Split billing
skills.description: Allocates shared trip costs across travelers with receipts export
